Latest News

A Macro Analyst Just Set a New Bitcoin Price Target

Macro strategist Mark Connors says US Treasury bond buybacks
could remove Bitcoin's biggest macro headwind and pull the next
major move meaningfully closer. He had expected Bitcoin to stay
subdued until November but said this week's Treasury action has
changed that calculus.

His full cycle target runs from $180,000 to $360,000 by 2030,
contingent on a second catalyst he says is still pending.

What second policy change does Connors say will trigger
Bitcoin's move to $180K?

Today, we’re diving into Ramp's launch of Router.com to see why the product they shipped alongside it, not the router LLM itself, is the bigger move here (the Stripe vs Ramp routing war, how USDC agent wallets turn AI agents into controlled corporate spenders, who wins between developers and CFOs + bonus deep dives into How to Build an Agentic OS with Claude Fable 5 [ https://substack.com/redirect/460e1710-37f4-4322-ac9b-4945d60afd87?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] & The AI Monopoly Playbook [ https://substack.com/redirect/b8b76725-24bc-4aff-b51b-0efa4d8684cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and Stripe's leaked investor letter to see why Patrick Collison told his investors the singularity started on January 1st and what that means for the $7B OpenRouter deal (Stripe's H1 2026 financials, the "two currencies" thesis that reframes the entire acquisition, plus the product stack that turns tokens into a payment rail + bonus deep dive into The Ultimate Guide to Qwen3.8-27B [ https://substack.com/redirect/5f03e78c-4d0c-4418-8434-22281c7d5473?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s jump straight into the finnovative stuff 🌶️
Ramp is building the CFO for AI Agents 📊🤖
The news 🗞️ When we first covered Ramp Router [ https://substack.com/redirect/bc13d98a-fbf7-4cfd-813c-1d522d21a13a?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] on July 22, we clearly said it is not a product but rather a wedge into AI spend management. A month later, the picture is even bigger than we thought.
On Wednesday, Ramp launched Router.com, an AI model routing service built on 3 years of internal production use. Hours earlier, Stripe had officially confirmed its $7.5B acquisition of OpenRouter [ https://substack.com/redirect/83a63b66-0f63-49d1-b8df-9b2c21b1ef23?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], the developer-favorite model marketplace, at nearly 6x the valuation it held just three months prior.
These two companies are not strangers. Stripe co-led Ramp’s 2021 Series B at a $1.6B valuation and still provides card-issuing and stablecoin infrastructure that Ramp relies on today.
Now they want the same layer: the routing decision that determines which AI model gets paid per request. And that’s before you account for what Ramp shipped alongside the router. That second product may actually matter more than the router itself...

## ChatGPT just got 100 billion new sources

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/1e93d0a5-56b2-401e-977c-1e4e709a2ea0/ChatGPT_Image_Aug_21__2026__01_07_48_AM.png?t=1787263896)
Caption: 

OpenAI spent Thursday [pointing developers](https://x.com/openaidevs/status/2090480484107141493) at someone else's search engine. The Exa plugin opens more than 100 billion websites, docs, papers, people and companies to ChatGPT Work and Codex.

Setup takes about a minute. Open Codex, go to Plugins, find Exa, hit install. Terminal people can run codex mcp add exa --url https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp instead.

What changes is where answers come from. Instead of leaning on what the model remembers, your agent pulls current sources mid-task. That matters most when you ask about a company, a person or a paper newer than its training data.

The gap between an agent that guesses and an agent that checks is most of what makes these things useful.
